health: const base = 'http://127.0.0.1:' + (Number(process.env.PORT) || 3000); Promise.all([fetch(base + '/healthz'), fetch(base + '/version').then(r => r.ok ? r.json() : {})]).then(([health, version]) => process.exit(health.ok && version.appBuild === '{sha7}' ? 0 : 1)).catch(() => process.exit(1))
